works.title: OtMartina | Popcorn Packaging
works.cardAlt: Colorful popcorn packaging design for the OtMartina brand.
works.subtitle: A vibrant popcorn packaging system inspired by the magic of every pop.
works.brandStory:
Popcorn is more than a snack - it's a moment of excitement. This packaging was designed to capture the magical transformation that happens when every kernel bursts into life, turning an everyday product into a playful visual experience.
The identity combines vibrant colors, floating popcorn illustrations, and a charismatic brand mascot to create a package that immediately stands out on the shelf. Every design element reinforces energy, fun, and the anticipation of the next pop.
A flexible visual system was developed across multiple flavors, maintaining strong brand recognition while allowing each product to express its own personality through color and illustration.
The result is a bold and memorable packaging system that transforms a simple snack into a recognizable brand with high shelf impact and a modern, engaging presence across retail and digital platforms.

works.title: HAR Energy Drink Packaging
works.cardAlt: Modern energy drink can packaging featuring a bold H-shaped identity across multiple flavors.
works.subtitle: A vibrant packaging system inspired by the different forms of energy.
works.brandStory:
This project explores how different forms of energy can be translated into a bold and memorable visual identity. Each flavor represents a unique type of energy from ice and fire to power, wildness, and vibrant fruit expressed through distinctive colors and atmospheric textures.
At the heart of the design is a large symbolic "H", transforming the brand's initial into a dynamic graphic element that instantly captures attention. Combined with clean typography and a modern can layout, the identity creates a strong shelf presence while remaining highly recognizable across the entire product range.
Every flavor is built around its own visual atmosphere without losing the consistency of the brand system. The result is a flexible packaging family that communicates movement, strength, and personality, delivering a modern energy drink experience that stands apart from conventional competitors.

works.title: GAUDÉLY Brand Identity
works.cardAlt: Luxury brand identity system for GAUDÉLY featuring logo design, typography, packaging, and social media assets.
works.subtitle: Elegant branding designed to communicate authenticity, trust, and timeless sophistication.
works.brandStory:
GAUDÉLY was created as a premium reseller brand focused on authentic watches and carefully selected luxury accessories. The goal was to build an identity that communicates trust, exclusivity, and timeless elegance while remaining modern and recognizable across every customer touchpoint.
The visual identity is centered around sophisticated typography and a distinctive symbolic "G", creating a memorable mark that reflects precision, heritage, and refined taste. A deep burgundy color palette reinforces the brand's premium positioning, while clean layouts and generous white space emphasize clarity and confidence.
Beyond the logo, the identity extends into packaging, printed materials, social media, and digital communication, forming a consistent visual language that strengthens recognition across every platform.
The result is a complete branding system that elevates the shopping experience, positioning GAUDÉLY as a trusted destination for original luxury products with a modern and elegant presence.
